description: Defines a Timeslot class with label and date, used for representing time slots in the application.

classes.name: Timeslot
classes.description: Represents a time slot with a label and a specific date.

methods.name: Timeslot(String label, int month, int day)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label and sets the date to the current year with specified month and day.

methods.name: getLabel()
methods.description: Returns the label of the timeslot.

methods.name: getTime()
methods.description: Returns the Calendar object representing the timeslot's date and time.
